links.outcome: Share of LLM-extracted confidential excerpts accurately derived from source note (no hallucination)
links.effect: Only 40 of 306 excerpts (13%) were accurately derived from the original note without hallucination; 22 (7%) represented the actual confidential content.
links.quote: Only 40 of the 306 manually reviewed excerpts (13%) were accurately derived from the original note (ie. contained no hallucinations), 22 (7%) of which represented the note’s actual confidential content.

unlisted_practices: Using a few-shot prompted LLM to flag confidential adolescent content in free-text notes to prevent unintended portal disclosure to guardians

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability and error profile (including hallucination rate and low specificity) of an LLM (GPT-3.5) to identify confidential adolescent health information in clinical encounter notes retrospectively, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
